items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: I was playing with Frankie Dusen then.

ctx.x: Yeah. And you know like the band, the jazz band would meet on Sundays on advertising and buck against one another. Yeah. So I'd pull up there by Pete Lacoste and he'd be trembling, you know. Thought I was going to buck against him. I wouldn't buck. I'd just wave, you know, and go by. And me and Rene never did buck. And then Buddy Petit, we never did buck together, you know. But Punch and all them other trumpet players, you know. Chris Kelly? Yeah. Chris Kelly. They stopped in the back there, that time they had…
He wouldn't even stay there and fight it out.
